name: Lorenz-96 Ring
desc: A scrolling Hovmoller space-time diagram of the Lorenz-96 toy-climate: a ring of coupled variables breeds travelling wavefronts of spatiotemporal chaos that sweep and merge across the frame, forcing drifting from ordered waves into full turbulence as the sections build.

gain.doc: value contrast (higher = more saturated blue/red, less white)

scale.doc: vertical zoom of the ring (higher = thicker wave bands)

force.doc: Lorenz-96 forcing F baseline (low=ordered waves, high=chaos)

density.doc: ring resolution N (finer wavefronts) — rebuilds sim
